attribution_rules.CALIBRATION_BOUNDARY_ERROR: raw ensemble threshold decision is correct at the mistaken anchor but calibrated ensemble flips it
attribution_rules.FRONTIER_LABEL_INSTABILITY: an independent valid same-context replay contradicts the original anchor outcome defining F_star
attribution_rules.RAW_MODEL_ERROR: raw local ordering is nonmonotonic beyond 0.02 or raw mistaken-anchor decision is wrong by >0.15 without unstable real label evidence
attribution_rules.THRESHOLD_ONLY_ERROR: raw and calibrated local ordering are non-decreasing and mistaken calibrated anchor is within 0.15 of 0.5 without a calibration flip

decision_rules.FIX_BACKEND_FIRST: either case has a HIGH/MEDIUM-confidence stable frontier plus confident raw wrong-side prediction, nonmonotonic response beyond tolerance, or absent adjacent force sensitivity not attributable to calibration/seed variance
decision_rules.GO_CONTINUOUS: both errors are one 0.5N step; no high-confidence stable-label raw force-sensitivity failure; curves are locally non-decreasing/smooth within tolerance; and each error is explained by threshold/calibration/seed variance or LOW-confidence contradictory frontier replay

ensemble_rules.calibrated: mean of per-seed TRAIN-only isotonic probability
ensemble_rules.selection: minimum authoritative force with ensemble probability >=0.5

frontier_confidence.HIGH: at least two independent consistent observations at both boundary anchors
frontier_confidence.LOW: independent valid replay contradicts either boundary-defining anchor
frontier_confidence.MEDIUM: single authoritative observation with consistent neighbor evidence and no contradiction

metrics.input_distance: TRAIN-normalized H8 x, force column excluded; Euclidean RMS
metrics.nearby_contexts: up to 3 same-task exact-correct DEV contexts, ordered by same-band then mu distance then input distance

offgrid_model_only.role: diagnostic only; no simulator execution; no inferred crossing is a real continuous F_star

raw_logit_extraction: direct frozen PREPROBE_FEASIBILITY forward pass using checkpoint-embedded TRAIN normalization
single_goal: Attribute the only two strict pre-probe GT discrete frontier errors and choose GO_CONTINUOUS or FIX_BACKEND_FIRST.
